title: TriggerDataEvent
description: Message published to the trigger.data Kafka topic by ui-gateway. Every analysis value, full_pipeline included, is minted by POST /analyses — the daily CronJob calls that route like any other client, so no execution exists that GET /analyses cannot answer for. Consumed by data-runner's `consume` mode.

runId.description: UUID minted by ui-gateway and returned as `id` on POST /analyses, for every analysis including the scheduled full_pipeline.

updateKey.description: Credential for PATCH /analyses/{id}. Travels only on this message — never in the HTTP 202 — so only the consumer can update status.
